applyTo: "**/module7/**"

# Module 7 — inheritance and polymorphism

Allowed: modules 1–6, plus `extends`, `super`, overriding, overloading, polymorphism, and abstract classes and methods.

Do not suggest or require: interfaces, `implements`, nested classes, inner classes, anonymous classes, collections, regular expressions, exceptions, `try`, `catch`, `throw`, lambda expressions, method references, `Optional`, the Date-Time API, the Stream API, threads, files, or web APIs.

Do not ask to replace a superclass with an interface.
